overview: Welcome to a new branch of the Duncan family tree, known for their popular casino / nightclub ‘Midnight Blues' where tourists, titans of industry, and trap kings & queens party side-by-side. But the club also holds secrets so dark that it could turn the vibrant city of New Orleans upside down. Facing threats at every turn, the Duncans try to keep their family safe and put their complicated pasts to the side for the greater good of their enduring legacy in the NOLA.
title: Carl Weber's The Family Business: New Orleans

overview: Lokala Skandaler is a series in which Kalla fakta examines revelations that shook Swedish towns. The episodes are based on news events that upset and arouse emotions. With the help of local reporters and residents, Emil Hellerud and Carolina Jemsby dig further into the cases in search of more answers. We meet heroes, designated villains and local residents who are affected by the decisions in the corridors of power.
title: Kalla Fakta Lokala Skandaler

overview: Koda Mari is a green-haired police officer in the International Investigation Unit of the Higashi-Shinjuku Police Department. Energetic and cheerful, she's dedicated to helping anyone in need, regardless of nationality. Arikino Ryo is a Chinese interpreter at the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Interpretation Center. He has committed himself to providing precise translations between officers, witnesses, and suspects. However, he decides to leave the police force after a painful incident. When Mari and Ryo cross paths, they join forces to solve all sorts of multinational cases. As they interact with foreign residents and share meals from around the world, Mari and Ryo's journey sheds light on the challenges and experiences of living in a foreign land.
title: Tokyo Salad Bowl

overview: Herbert Ballerina, Brenda Lodigiani, Antonio Ornano, Awed, Ginevra Fenyes, Pierluca Mariti, Michela Giraud, Gabriele Vagnato, and Francesco Arienzo are the bodyguards in the first edition of "Red Carpet Survival." The best team, at the end of the four episodes, will win the coveted Golden Pigeon. Alessia Marcuzzi will lead the bodyguards. Commenting on it all are the voices of Gialappa's Band.
title: Red Carpet - Vip al tappeto

overview: "Ekiben" are lunch boxes sold at train stations enjoyed during train journeys which are filled with the charm of each region of Japan! Let's embark on a journey to encounter a selection of lunch boxes from all over Japan!
title: Ekiben Japan

overview: Conversations about the nature of intelligence, consciousness, love, and power.
title: Lex Fridman

overview: Shen Nan and Gu Shi Wen become family after each other's parents remarry. They fall in love with each other, and the gentle Shen Nan helps heal Gu Shi Wen's heart. However, their love gets hindered, and Shen Nan tries everything to turn back time, prevent tragedy and fight against destiny...
title: I'll Turn Back This Time

overview: Yuzuhara Miku is a temporary employee who works for a reception desk at a department store. She has low self confidence and worries about what others think of her, but is clueless when it comes to makeup. Her elite lawyer boyfriend Haruhisa however, constantly tells her she he prefers seeing her that way, so she wore minimal makeup because he favors her "modest" look. One day, she meets Takakura Eve, a guy with a special love for makeup. When he applied red lipstick on her, Miku felt a sense of exhilaration. However, when Haruhisa found out about this, he transforms into an emotionally abusive man.
title: Makeup With Mud

overview: The Weekend View will focus on the biggest stories in entertainment and the buzziest news topping social media feeds. With all-new "Hot Topics," the co-hosts will give their one-of-a-kind takes with their signature candor and humor. Plus, "The Weekend View" will include "Behind the Table" segments with executive producer Brian Teta and the co-hosts as they dive deeper into pop-culture stories from the week.
title: The Weekend View

overview: They're the wives and girlfriends of famous athletes and rap stars, but these stylishly smart W.A.G.s call the shots in this soapy reality series.
title: W.A.G.s to Riches

overview: The Curious Case Of… will dive into some of the most shocking true crime cases and unbelievable scandals. From a con man with multiple identities whose crimes stretch across the globe to a religious doomsday cult centered around worshipping cats, each episode will go inside these real-life cases exposing bizarre secrets, shattered lives, and twisted motives. Led by Karas, with her extensive legal expertise and insight, each gripping story will uncover deceit, greed, and manipulation and offer key access to shocking, first-hand accounts - proving the truth is much more chilling than fiction.
title: The Curious Case Of…

overview: A triangle drama between married couple Markus and Marianne and their best friend David, where desire, jealousy and betrayal destroy both friendship and love relationships. But above all, it is Markus and Marianne's daughter Isabelle who has been hit hard. Based on a story by Ingmar Bergman.
title: Trolösa

overview: Kan, a hot-headed college freshman who is bad at socializing, is invited by his senior Ton to go on a motorcycle getaway trip with friends. Kan invites his girlfriend, Toey, a third-year engineering student to go with him to get to know his friends. The trip seems fun until Kan's hot-headed nature brings about unexpected events.
title: Yoo Tee Rao

overview: Aurélie, an inspector who clumsily let a young man suspected of being involved in the disappearance of his girlfriend go, learns that he was arrested on a Swiss merchant navy cargo ship for the murder of a sailor. Sent to South Africa to repatriate him, she discovers that the missing girl was a passenger on this cargo ship a few weeks earlier. She continues her investigation alone, facing resistance from the crew.
title: En haute mer

overview: Song Dianxin, feamale general of Haiyin Kingdom, was accused of treason and died. Before this, she learned that she was betrayed by her fiancé, Shen Musi. Luckily, Song Dianxin is reborn and then immediately breaks off the engagement. She fights against the despicable man and avenges her friends who hurted her. However, it turns out that Shen Musi was also a victim of treachery. After his own rebirth, he pursues his love while investigating the truth. This leads to an intense love-hate relationship with Song Dianxin, full of cat-and-mouse dynamics.
title: Born to Die

overview: The story of three friends: a private detective with the ability to read minds, a lawyer with the gift of seeing a person's future, and a priest with the gift of seeing the past. All of them, thanks to their abilities, have settled down quite well in life. But at some point, someone appears on the horizon who wants to take revenge on them for what they did in the distant past.
title: Гипнозис

overview: "A world without prisons" - that is the revolutionary goal of Trust, a rehabilitation program in North Rhine-Westphalia. The program manager Petra Schach promises released prisoners work, housing, therapy and a life of freedom! A Better Place tells the story of a city without prisons from multiple perspectives. Dystopia or the turning point towards a better world?!?
title: A Better Place

overview: Based on the eponymous book by Argentine author Hernán Casciari and inspired by real events, "The Best Heart Attack of My Life" follows a frustrated writer who survives a heart attack thanks to the help of his hosts at the temporary rental house where he is staying. It's an event that will change his life, and that of those around him, forever.
title: El Mejor Infarto de mi Vida

overview: Health Uncensored with Dr. Drew. is an innovative, informative and entertaining new National Television Series. Dr. Drew Pinsky introduces us to the most important ideas in the new era of health and medicine. From the latest medical breakthroughs to simple home health solutions, Dr. Drew discusses it all with leading experts. Health Uncensored with Dr. Drew topics are timely and compelling, including brain health, emotional resilience, vitality and aging, super foods for cancer prevention, and the "magic pill" of exercise. The program also informs us about the role each of us play in creating a healthier life and world. Dr. Drew brings his insight and knowledge to each episode as he presents a truly global picture of health practices, both new and time-tested.
title: Health Uncensored with Dr. Drew

overview: The nation's outdoor home. From the humble backyard to the grandest of grounds, what do Britain's gardens tell us about our culture, climate and history?
title: Monty Don's British Gardens

overview: Hélène Hendriks kicks off the year with 'De Oranjewinter'. In this winter version of her successful talk show 'De Oranjezomer' she receives changing guests with whom she discusses the latest news.
title: De Oranjewinter

overview: Young Aurore Dupin seeks to escape the violence of her husband Baron Dudevant, who is ready to do anything to keep her under his control. Her two children and her passion for writing are her only reasons for living. However, her meeting with Jules Sandeau, who shares her love of writing, gives her hope of one day becoming a free woman. While her husband hatches a plan to prevent her from leaving the Nohant estate, Aurore persuades her young lover to follow her to Paris where they can finally live out their passion in complete freedom...
title: La rebelle - Les aventures de la jeune George Sand

overview: Gerry Star is a hit producer, heartthrob and businessman - at least that's what he thinks. But in reality, he lives in a bowling alley and only dreams of a big breakthrough with his band ‘Family Strike'. In reality, however, the road to fame is full of obstacles, because everything Gerry Star touches backfires...
title: Gerry Star

overview: Gerard Joling and Gordon stay and work three days with a family, club or company. These are places that are totally different from their everyday lives. The two "divas" do not know in advance where they are going. Frequently they fail to perform tasks assigned. The program is based on the format that formed the basis for the series The Simple Life with Paris Hilton and Nicole Richie, that looks like the comedy TV series Green Acres.
title: Joling & Gordon over de vloer

overview: Participants in the series parody Algorytm miłości put their fate in the hands of artificial intelligence to find a perfectly matched love and win the program. Find out how much you can do for reach, fame and money! The new series from the creators of The Office PL is not only a sharp parody of reality, but of the entire entertainment and mass entertainment. Because although sometimes it is embarrassing to admit it, we all love it.
title: Algorytm miłości

overview: In the six-part series Breaking Beyond, six breakers discover the dance, breaking and hip hop culture in different cities around the world. In every episode, we follow each breaker as a host in a big metropole in their home countries, and learn about their lives and background stories. Every B-Boy and B-Girl's story is unique, and the contrasts between them show us how diverse the global breaking culture is. In the destination cities, the breakers are divided into hosts and guests, where one will take on the other and show them their culture, lifestyle and country. They will take a deep dive into the city's hip hop culture with a strong focus on break dancing.
title: Breaking Beyond

overview: Join Onya Nurve as she says "Hello! Hello! Hello!" to the queens of RuPaul's Drag Race Season 18! Get an in-depth look at the queen's audition tapes and find out what the cast really thinks about each other when the library is opened.
title: HELLO HELLO HELLO

overview: For nine years, the Norwegian Crown Prince Harald and commoner Sonja Haraldsen fight for their right to marry, but the decision lies with King Olav. The Norwegian constitution bars Harald from marrying without royal consent, risking the monarchy's collapse. Defying tradition, the couple stands against the royal court, government, and press—all for love.
title: Harald og Sonja

overview: During a deadly snowstorm, a train from Stockholm to Narvik collides with an avalanche, and the passengers are forced to take shelter in an isolated hotel. Among them is the sharp but suspended murder investigator Hanne Wilhelmsen). At the hotel, two mysterious murders take place. Together with the Norwegian doctor Magnus, Hanne tries to find out what has happened.
title: Blindspår

overview: Austin Healey presents The Fuse - an explosive daytime quiz show on ITV1.
title: The Fuse

overview: Rekviem for Selina is about 17-year-old Selina, who, in an attempt to get revenge on her bullies, gets into trouble to change the world. Selina goes from being an outsider who writes a diary on the internet, to becoming the country's most dangerous role model with more readers than the country's largest newspapers.
title: Rekviem for Selina

overview: A series of three documentaries lifting the lid on the crisis in global finance.
title: The City Uncovered with Evan Davis

overview: Six young people with various disabilities have a big goal this winter. Will they be able to complete a ski race on the demanding trails used during the World Ski Championships in Trondheim?
title: Team Pølsa

overview: How well prepared are we for the next disaster? Andreas Wahl puts Norway to the test through six fictional but realistic disaster scenarios.
title: Katastrofe

overview: What happens when doctors discover a huge brain tumor in a five-year-old child? What do plastic surgeons do when they discover that a two-year-old girl's foot is infested with flesh-eating bacteria?
title: Barnesykehuset

overview: For the very first time, a Norwegian junior baking champion will also be crowned! Eight talented kids between the ages of 10 and 13 will take over the baking tent to compete until the flour flies, the laughter bubbles and the tears flow. In the junior Baking Championship, they give it their all to impress the judges with the most beautiful pastries. Along the way, they also become friends and each other's best helpers.
title: Bakemesterskapet junior

overview: A series looking at building planning processes.
title: The Planners Are Coming

overview: Cem, scarred by a childhood that crushed his trust in love, is the invisible hero of Love Hospital, a place he established to cure those suffering from the "love disease." All of Cem's success and dreams now depend on Hazal, an unexpected presence in his life who, in stark contrast to him, believes that love will save the world.
title: Adsız Aşıklar

overview: From Maxine Productions (the producers behind Quiet on Set: The Dark Side of Kids TV) and Rolling Stone Films, the docuseries features exclusive, never-before-heard accounts and never-before-seen archival footage, offering personal insights into harrowing allegations of violent behavior and illegal activity that have shadowed the music mogul. Spanning Combs' decades-long impact on music and popular culture, from his early days as a talented creative to his 2024 arrest, the docuseries uncovers the insidious and terrifying allegations of sexual assault, abusive behavior, violence, and other disturbing claims that lay beneath his success.
title: The Fall of Diddy

overview: Six famous Norwegians are going to climb the world's coldest mountain, Denali in Alaska. Now they have to bring everything they have – because this will be both tough and dangerous.
title: Ekspedisjonen

overview: Britain's most successful young entrepreneurs compete to see who can create the most profitable businesses in six cities across the world.
title: The Last Millionaire

overview: The story follows the relationship between the two girls, Sayuri and Yui, as they start to live together under one roof as step-sisters. Despite their initial distaste for each other and the fact that they couldn't be more opposite in looks and personality, they eventually start to develop feelings for each other... How will their romance take shape?
title: Transit Girls

overview: A selection of archive news stories, looking back at the headlines of the past 20 years, accompanied by a soundtrack of music of the time.
title: Don't Look Back in Anger

overview: TV show about video games for game consoles Dendy (Famicom clone), Sega, Game Boy and Super Nintendo.
title: Денди — Новая реальность

overview: A story about cult works and their sequels, without which it is difficult to imagine the landscape of modern cinema.
title: Кинопоиск: Любимые франшизы

overview: About how sport goes beyond arenas, points and seconds and influences the world around it. Each episode is dedicated to a separate sporting event or an important tournament.
title: Кинопоиск: Как устроен спорт

overview: In Pattaya, three adopted brothers run a bicycle café together. The gentle and composed eldest, Nub-Nueng, is a psychologist. The second brother, Tawan, is a former pilot haunted by the trauma of a plane crash. The youngest, Sky, is a top nightclub host. Each faces a different challenge in love: Nub-Nueng meets Sailom, who suffers from androphobia; Tawan reunites with Dindin, a one-night stand from his past; and Sky finds himself evenly matched with sharp-witted business elite Nava. Through a transformative cycling journey, the three brothers ride toward their own destinations of happiness.
title: Love Like A Bike

overview: A documentary series from Kinopoisk with an analysis of the most important things that came out in 2023: Barbie, Oppenheimer, Killers of the Flower Moon, The Last of Us. First published on Kinopoisk's YouTube channel.
title: Кинопоиск: Каким мы запомним 2023 год

overview: Welcome to the CIRCLE. Eight people gather around the table to play eight games. But they don't even know that it's them who will get played. The winner will receive 1,000,000 rubles. Anton Shastun, Dima Pozov, Sergey Matvienko and Arseniy Popov each selected two participants to advance to the final.
title: Круг

overview: John Calipari always finds a way to win, and Arkansas is counting on just that. But in the chaotic world of college hoops, it's never been harder to build a winner. There's no time to waste, as Calipari tries to mold young men into champions.
title: Calipari: Razor's Edge

overview: The St. John's Red Storm are on a mission to end a 25-year drought without an NCAA Tournament win. Their head coach, Rick Pitino, has much bigger goals. Entering his 50th year of coaching, Pitino is looking to make one more run in a legendary career.
title: Pitino: Red Storm Rising

overview: Mexico is a land of lush tropical jungles, orange sunburnt deserts, vast green pine forests, white snow-capped volcanoes and deep blue lakes, and each of these amazing landscapes is inhabited by a surprising range of wildlife and human cultures.
title: Wild Mexico

overview: Criminologist David Wilson investigate UK murder cases, revealing motives, patterns, and the psychology of killers.
title: Murder UK

overview: Marcel Theroux explores the dark and disturbing world of The Eunuch Maker.
title: The Eunuch Maker

overview: Cameras follow a specialist police unit dealing with urgent manhunts.
title: Manhunt

overview: Julia's job is both passion and danger: she is a professional snake catcher in Brisbane, Australia. A place with one of the highest snake populations in the world. Many of the species that live there are dangerous, poisonous and some of them are even deadly. No place is safe anymore, the snakes are everywhere. Julia finds the dangerous animals in kindergartens, bedrooms, toilets and air conditioning systems. And the snake season has just begun. The Australian's everyday life is full of action, excitement and driven by her customers who find themselves in tricky situations. As a professional snake catcher, only she is able to master this dangerous job. Julia's goal is to ensure that no one gets hurt or even bitten by one of the deadliest snakes in the world: the Eastern brown snake. Because there are plenty of them in Julia's area of operation.
title: Die Schlangenfängerin - Gefahr Down Under

overview: The series' creators let viewers into their creative process: they tell how they brought the punk band's story to the screen, discuss its contribution to music, and even compete in their knowledge of KiSh's work.
title: Король и Шут: Экстра

overview: Dao Panprakai, a famous and perfect theatre actress, unexpectedly finds herself attending her own funeral. After discovering her boyfriend's affair with another man, she fakes a suicide to gain attention, only to accidentally die for real. Her friend Khunphol, an acting coach, doubts her death was intentional, leading Dao to try to communicate with him and uncover the truth behind her demise.
title: The Musical Murder

overview: Based on the bestselling book series A Song of Ice and Fire by George R.R. Martin, this sprawling new HBO drama is set in a world where summers span decades and winters can last a lifetime. From the scheming south and the savage eastern lands, to the frozen north and ancient Wall that protects the realm from the mysterious darkness beyond, the powerful families of the Seven Kingdoms are locked in a battle for the Iron Throne. This is a story of duplicity and treachery, nobility and honor, conquest and triumph. In the Game of Thrones, you either win or you die.
title: Game of Thrones

overview: Hung follows Ray Drecker, a middle-aged basketball coach and high school history teacher who figures out how to put his exceptional physical endowments to use and change his fortunes. Forced to find an alternative sources of income after a series of unfavorable events, Ray takes on a whole new profession aided by his pimp and business partner, Tanya Skagle.
title: Hung

overview: Fox News Tonight will air live as an interim show helmed by rotating FOX News personalities.
title: Fox News Tonight

overview: Determined to seize the day, National Treasure Miriam Margolyes leaps across the ditch and dives headfirst into a new country, on a fresh journey full of surprising contradictions, new challenges, unexpected lessons and revealing stories.
title: Miriam Margolyes in New Zealand

overview: In the locker room, Stéphane welcomes the new members of the swimming club. Pierre, the team coach, unveils the club's new official outfit. Reactions are mixed. Everything gets tougher when it comes time to choose their rallying cry.
title: Vestiaires

overview: It's All Geek to Me is a television program created and that is broadcast on the Science Channel. It first aired on May 18, 2007. To describe it, Pogue writes in his blog, "What is it? Think 'funny cooking show'—except instead of whipping up food, I'll be whipping up technology projects!"
title: It's All Geek to Me

overview: The female CEO took a fancy to the male bartender, and the two had a passionate night. Si Nan offered to support Bai Zi Hao with a high salary to help him with his sister's medical expenses. In fact, her real purpose was to transplant his kidney to her brother, who suffered from uremia. Bai Zi Hao also pretended to be a prey to be approached by a rich woman. The sister who suffered from leukemia was actually his childhood sweetheart, An Ran. After An Ran met Si Nan's rich brother, she didn't want to live a poor life with the bartender anymore. She lied that she had leukemia to make him give up. At the same time, Si Nan and Bai Zi Hao became more emotionally involved as they spent time together and got along. He wanted to stop the loss in time and was ready to run, but found out that An Ran was with Si Nan's brother. All the scams were revealed.
title: Fake Love

overview: "Listen to the Earth" is a disaster prevention series where children and adults alike are encouraged to give serious thought to the topic. Japan is often struck by various natural disasters, with many people having lost their lives in the Great Hanshin and Great East Japan Earthquakes. Both children and adults alike should consider how to protect themselves in such disasters by understanding how these natural disasters occur, and practice preventive measures. This series aims to foster correct understanding of disasters by demonstrating the damage they can cause, and how they occur in the first place. The audience can consider what measures to take to protect themselves and their family if they are ever in a disaster situation while learning from specialists and taking part in quizzes.
title: Listen to the Earth

overview: Based on the life of An Katsumasa, a Korean psychiatrist who lived in Japan, this series tells the story of one doctor's capacity for love. When the Great Hanshin Earthquake strikes Japan in January 1995, protagonist An Kazutaka springs into action to care for the mental health of others, even though he is a victim himself. He listens to the concerns of earthquake survivors, empathizes with their pain, and eventually becomes a pioneer researcher of PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder) in Japan. An's deep bond with his wife, who stays by his side through many hardships, is also depicted, as are the heartfelt ties he forms with his patients.
title: To Heal The Heart

overview: Jiang Ci You had just married Yan Feng, but he eloped abroad with her best friend Xia Ling. Having been betrayed twice, Jiang Ci You kept a pretty boy named Bo Jin Xiu. She didn't know that this pretty boy was the famous prince of Beijing. Bo Jin Xiu was willing to be her canary for the past two years. Jiang Ci You's husband came back and wanted to break up with her. Bo Jin Xiu decisively restored his identity and took steps to marry her.
title: Wo Yang De Xiao Bai Lian Shi Jing Quan Tai Zi Ye

overview: Collegiate Komugi Yamashita lives with her retired policeman father, having lost her mother early on. But then her father is murdered, leaving only a letter cryptically naming a certain person as innocent should he ever be arrested or prosecuted. Learning the suspect is the son of a criminal executed 22 years ago, Komugi seeks the help of a lawyer Matsukaze named in the letter. But Matsukaze has never had any contact with Komugi's father. So the two go in search of the shocking truth.
title: Who Saw the Peacock Dance in the Jungle?

overview: The soon-to-be CEO of the Qin Corporation, Qin Nan, unexpectedly discovers her husband, Luo Sen, having an illicit affair with her father's secretary, Tong Qian. This betrayal drives her to the brink of despair. After being reborn, she resolves to uncover the truth behind the Qin Corporation's precarious situation. To solidify her position in the company, Qin Nan hires Fu Yunlan, the Chief Technology Officer of Simulation Cabin. With Fu Yunlan's help, she repeatedly thwarts the traps set by Tong Qian and Luo Sen. Amid the turmoil, an unexpected romance begins to blossom.Qin Nan uncovers evidence of Tong Qian's embezzlement and successfully forces her out, compelling Luo Sen, her accomplice, to flee in disgrace. However, she soon discovers the real reason Fu Yunlan joined the company: to investigate the truth behind his sister Fu Yunya's tragic death.Through their joint efforts, the criminal schemes of Zhao Zicheng, a business partner of the Qin Corporation, come to light. It is revealed that he sexually assaulted Fu Yunya, ultimately driving her to take her own life. Fu Yunlan's quest for revenge places him in grave danger, prompting Qin Nan to risk her life to save him. Together, they bring Zhao Zicheng to justice.Just when it seems everything has finally settled, Qin Nan is betrayed and imprisoned by her best friend, Xue Minmin, who is revealed to have been part of Tong Qian's long-laid schemes. In a life-and-death confrontation, Fu Yunlan takes a desperate risk, thwarting Tong Qian and Xue Minmin's plans but vanishing from Qin Nan's life in the process.Where did he go? After Qin Nan's countless fruitless searches, one quiet afternoon, he reappears before her once more...
title: She Rides the Wind

overview: Former pastry chef Julia Baker, aka Snake Boss, is a fearless snake charmer whose face-to-face encounters with Queensland's most dangerous reptiles are a regular day in the office. From uncovering deadly eastern brown snakes inside children's bedrooms to removing them off rooftops, this brand new series will follow Julia as she visits the homes of Brisbane residents to remove these unwanted slithering visitors. Brisbane is one of the most competitive places in the world for snake catchers and Julia Baker is one of just a handful of women in Australia relocating snakes for a living. Her foray into the snake catching industry started with a bucket list, and among the many bold goals she successfully ticked off, her greatest passion that remained was her love for snakes – in particular, the venomous species. And so this thrill seeker turned her passion into her profession, even recruiting her Scottish partner, Johnny Gallacher as her apprentice. Julia has made it her mission to help people understand snakes and not fear them. Follow her and her snake catching team, Johnny and their Jack Russell terrier, Bonnie on every slithery twist and turn as they rescue Brisbane's ophidiophobic residents (and face some of their own phobias) in Snake Boss.
title: Snake Boss

overview: The Luangwa Valley in Zambia is one of Africa's last great wildernesses. A rich mosaic of ebony forests and grassy plains, it's home to a vast array of colourful species including carmine-bee-eaters, hyenas, lions, vultures, crocodiles and insects such as praying mantis. This series follows the challenges the valley's wildlife must overcome during the long dry season as they await the life-giving rains.
title: The Big Dry

overview: The Swiss 3-Michelin-star chef Andreas Caminada embarks on a culinary journey to six different countries with six German-speaking celebrities, including actress Karoline Herfurth. In each episode, Caminada and one of the participants go in search of classic dishes, unusual ingredients and unique culinary experiences. At the end, the respective duo prepares a dinner for all the guests of the dinner club, bringing home the flavors and drinks tasted on the trip, along with the associated adventures and extraordinary stories behind each dish.
title: Dinner Club

overview: Pharmacy Norbert Polacsek is playing at the wedding with the new band of the former beat musician, Old Gold. She doesn't know yet that her Swiss aunt, Lydia, wants to buy the family pharmacy.
title: Patika

overview: MLB Network Presents is an original series of documentaries and access-driven profiles. Launched in January 2015, MLB Network Presents has produced programs covering many subjects across baseball, including the Emmy-nominated "The Story of Billy Bean" as well as "Holy Cow! The Story of Harry Caray," ".406," "56: The Streak," "The Bird," "The Colorful Montreal Expos" and "The Nasty Boys: The 1990 Cincinnati Reds."
title: MLB Network Presents

overview: Wide World of Sports presents the Australian Open 2025, live from Melbourne Park. Join Tony Jones along with the expert team for all the reviews, previews, interviews, highlights, opinions and topical issues. Live play from 11:00AM AEDT.
title: Australian Open Tennis - Pre-Show

overview: Wide World of Sports presents the 2025 Australian Open, live from Melbourne Park. Join host James Bracey with the expert team for all the action as the live coverage continues.
title: Australian Open Tennis - Late Night

overview: Section E is a notorious high school class full of mischief-loving male troublemakers. When Jay-Jay transfers into the class, becoming the only girl in Section E, her new classmates immediately begin to target her with cruel practical jokes and schemes – hoping to force her to quit. But the feisty, fearless, and independent-minded Jay-Jay refuses to play along. She soon shows the boys that she can give as good as she gets. The devilishly handsome class president Keifer resolves to use his charms to bring her guard down. But this plan begins to unravel as Cupid arrives on the scene. And a further wrinkle in Keifer's plan appears when their aloof classmate Yuri (Rabin Angeles) also begins to develop a soft spot for Jay-Jay. Does Jay-Jay have what it takes to survive the Section E ordeal – and will the pull of romance prove too strong for her would-be tormentors?
title: The Muse of Section E

overview: A love story between a 42 year old middle class, conservative single mother, Vedika and a 24 year old irresponsible, maverick, Sahil, from a traditional, super rich business family.
title: Aap Ke Aa Jane Se

overview: Fang Xin Yan was saved by the domineering boss. She made a deal with Jiang Ji Chun and lurked around his nephew to obtain information for him in exchange for clues about her family's murder. During this period, she was moved by the Jiang Ming Langs's gentleness and got involved in the fight between uncle and nephew, and the boss was already in love. As the clues slowly surfaced, it turned out that the real murderer had been hiding around her for a long time.
title: Ye Yan

overview: Documentary series following the lives of the families, babies, and staff in the busy newborn intensive care unit in Cork University Maternity Hospital.
title: Born Too Soon
